'''Chapter 1181''' is titled "God and Devil".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page]] Request: "[[Carrot]] singing and walking over [[Animal Species#Panda_Shark|Pan-Sharks]] lined up in the sea" by PN Michi Nakahara.

==Short Summary==
[[Nerona Imu|Imu]] fends off and injures [[Loki]] with his "[[Omen]]" ability, but Loki is able to retaliate by striking him into the [[Treasure Tree Adam]] with [[Ragnir]]. Loki then transforms into the [[Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr|Nidhöggr]], and Imu cracks a smile upon seeing it again.

==Long Summary==
Thinking back to that fateful day, [[Loki]] tells [[Nerona Imu|Imu]] that [[giants]] normally live to 300 years, but [[Harald]] was only 144 years old at death, so it should not have been his time to die. However, hearing Imu call him his servant has made him believe that he was the one who manipulated and ultimately killed him. Imu, however, replies that he was the one who was troubled by what happened that day. Loki then prepares an attack with [[Ragnir]] called ''Ragnaizuchi'' and brings the hammer, covered in lightning, down onto Imu while demanding to know what exactly he did to him. In turn, Imu conjures up an ''Omen'' to match Loki's attack, resulting in a massive shockwave that can be felt across Elbaph.

Loki is in disbelief that Imu was able to block such an attack and demands to know what his powers are. Imu, however, creates another ''Omen'' and this time, he absorbs it into his body, causing him to swell and grow into a giant himself to properly match Loki, to his surprise. Imu calls ''Omen'' his military might and a power that resides in all things as he once again blocks Loki's swing, but after doing so Imu jumps above Loki and creates a blade out of black flames from his staff, which he calls ''Sword of Judgement: Nemesis'', and impales Loki with it, causing him to fall down.

As Loki picks himself up, Imu says that it is the nature of man to crave strength, but when the power they lust after is too easily gained, it leads to "Corruption"; when someone chooses servitude out of self-interest, it leads to "Covenants"; and the envy of one who seeks to achieve their goal is the "Power of Omen"; these three, according to Imu, are the foundation of the power of "Domination", all the while he blasts Loki with another ball of black flames, which hits him point-blank and causing him to falter. Imu then offers Loki with "the power of a god" in order to surpass all others, but Loki rejects it and brings Ragnir down onto him, but Imu remains unscathed.

Heavily exhausted, Loki sits down and tells Imu that the power he claims is the strength of a God looks more like forming a pact with the Devil, but Imu says there is no difference between the two. Loki then gets back up and reaffirms that no one shall be his master as he prepares to attack, but Imu interjects that "Domination" is the only true bliss in the world, thinking back to a conversation with [[Joy Boy]] that leads to him calling out his name in anger. In the school, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], shaken by Imu's [[Haki]] and realizing that he cannot win with an empty stomach, continues eating as much food as he can to replenish his strength and rejoin the fight.

While Imu is distracted reminiscing about the past, his temporary lapse in focus allows Loki to strike him with Ragnir and blast him into the Adam Tree, claiming he does not respect him enough to allow himself to be distracted. Loki then transforms into his full Beast form and unleashes a ''Thorheim'' attack on Imu, who blocks it with his own powers. Imu then smiles when he sees Loki transformed, as he thinks that [[Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr|Nidhöggr]] has truly returned.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
* [[Nerona Imu|Imu]] resumes his battle with [[Loki]].
** Loki attacks Imu with ''Ragna Izuchi,'' but Imu blocks it with ''Omen''. Imu then gigantifies himself using ''Omen'' and impales Loki via ''Nemesis''.
* Imu describes his [[Akuma no Mi|powers]] as the one that resides in all things, and that it consists of "Corruption", "Covenant", and "Omen", which serve as the foundation of his power of "Domination".
* Imu offers the "power of a god" to Loki, which Loki declines.
** As the two clash again, Imu reminisces about his past conversation with [[Joy Boy]] which led to him calling out his name in anger.
* At the school, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] senses Imu's powerful [[Haki]] and continues eating to replenish himself.
* Loki strikes Imu with [[Ragnir]], launching him into the Adam Tree, then transforms into his beast form to attack him with ''Thorheim''.
** Upon witnessing Loki's transformation, Imu smiles as he thinks that [[Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr|Nidhöggr]] has returned.
